purpose: Define Absolute Base Zero plus additive USE/profile semantics: runtime capabilities start from an explicit minimum, components are enabled only by declared configuration, and dependencies validate without auto-enabling missing components.

topics.name: Boot Profile
topics.purpose: Define Absolute Base Zero plus additive USE/profile semantics: runtime capabilities start from an explicit minimum, components are enabled only by declared configuration, and dependencies validate without auto-enabling missing components.

semantics.enable_rule: Capabilities/components are additive from the baseline.
semantics.use_rule: When explicit use/user selection is present, only listed components are enabled subject to required baseline semantics.
semantics.dependency_rule: Dependencies are validated but never auto-enabled.
semantics.failure_rule: Missing required dependency causes hard failure with one clear remediation path.
semantics.pruning_rule: Negative pruning is explicit and must not produce hidden fallback capability.
semantics.autostart_rule: Only explicitly configured runtime components may autostart.
semantics.authority_rule: Boot configuration enables declared capability presence; it does not bypass later authority checks.

invariants.rule: Runtime capabilities, dispatch and mutable state remain explicit, bounded and Core-governed.

hard_gates.condition: boot configuration bypasses runtime authority validation
autostart order/capability inferred from filesystem presence

references.purpose: Enabled capability existence remains separate from permission.
Boot configuration and runtime state remain distinct.
